REQ-DATA-001.rationale: Persisting only data required for canonical results and safe resume limits stale configuration coupling and keeps verbose provider exchanges outside the authoritative project contract.
REQ-DATA-001.requirement: The authoritative Chunking document shall not persist AI profile identity, model or request parameters, profile history, budget metadata, runtime progress, derived counts, generic metadata, or transaction-log paths; AI transaction logs shall remain separate artifacts and Reset Chunking shall remove them.
REQ-DATA-001.verification: Persisted Chunking data excludes runtime/profile/budget/log-path fields and logs remain separate.

REQ-FUNC-001.rationale: The project manifest is the durable coordination point for every downstream workflow and must remain usable without rewriting domain artifacts during repair.
REQ-FUNC-001.requirement: The application shall create, open, validate, save, and metadata-repair a flat project workspace while presenting manifest-derived lifecycle state through the Home flow.
REQ-FUNC-001.verification: Existing focused workspace suite: linked lifecycle, manifest validation, repair, and recovery behavior after traceability review.

REQ-FUNC-002.rationale: A stable local source record is required before extraction, while replacement must not delete files outside the project.
REQ-FUNC-002.requirement: Before project options are locked, the application shall import or replace one supported source file inside the project root and return normalized source metadata with collision-safe storage.
REQ-FUNC-002.verification: Automated focused pytest coverage passed for supported source copy, metadata, collision handling, and safe replacement.

REQ-FUNC-003.rationale: Exports are delivery views of established workflow artifacts and must neither expose internal AI transaction logs nor become runtime state.
REQ-FUNC-003.requirement: The Home flow shall expose readiness-based external TXT, Markdown, and ZIP exports that project current usable artifacts into operator-facing deliverables without changing the active project.
REQ-FUNC-003.verification: Automated focused pytest coverage passed for export readiness, archive exclusions, external-path enforcement, and Home enablement.

REQ-FUNC-004.rationale: Operators need a portable project backup that cannot recursively include itself or leave a partial final archive.
REQ-FUNC-004.requirement: The Home flow shall create a cancellable external ZIP snapshot of regular project files under one top-level project folder, excluding symlinks and AI transaction logs and publishing the final archive only after successful completion.
REQ-FUNC-004.verification: Automated focused pytest coverage passed for snapshot structure, cancellation cleanup, active-operation blocking, and Home enablement.

REQ-FUNC-005.rationale: Cleanup requires one stable local text input while operators must be able to rerun extraction without losing the imported source.
REQ-FUNC-005.requirement: The application shall extract supported TXT, Markdown, PDF, RTF, DOCX, ODT, and EPUB project sources into normalized canonical text with self-contained extraction state and report artifacts, and extraction reset shall preserve the registered source document.
REQ-FUNC-005.verification: Automated focused pytest coverage passed for supported extraction formats, canonical artifacts, no-OCR rejection, and source-preserving reset.

REQ-FUNC-006.rationale: Deterministic cleanup must improve extracted text without silently discarding meaningful multilingual story content or creating divergent text copies.
REQ-FUNC-006.requirement: Deterministic cleanup shall conservatively remove page artifacts, repair page-boundary and dialogue structure, detect supported language/script/chapter cues, and persist canonical clean text plus paragraph metadata that does not duplicate paragraph text.
REQ-FUNC-006.verification: Existing focused deterministic-cleanup suite: linked structure, recovery, page-boundary, dialogue, multilingual, and page-artifact behavior after traceability review.

REQ-FUNC-007.rationale: Provider output is untrusted and must not reorder or silently lose meaningful source text; deterministic rendering and offline spacing changes keep cleanup review reproducible.
REQ-FUNC-007.requirement: AI cleanup shall validate ordered source-derived blocks that cover every non-whitespace source character exactly once, render artifact types deterministically, persist review artifacts, and reapply compatible spacing selections without another provider call.
REQ-FUNC-007.verification: Existing focused AI cleanup service suite: linked persistence, prompt, schema, budget/window, resume, and corrupt-artifact recovery behavior after traceability review.

REQ-FUNC-008.rationale: The UI and later workflow stages need one consistent projection of cleanup state and predictable invalidation after operator changes.
REQ-FUNC-008.requirement: Text Cleanup state orchestration shall build source and cleaned previews from project artifacts, save confirmed manual clean-text edits, apply compatible AI spacing, derive manifest transitions, and reset cleanup or downstream artifacts according to workflow impact while preserving extraction when requested.
REQ-FUNC-008.verification: Automated focused pytest coverage passed for page-state projection, manual edits, spacing, manifest transitions, and cleanup/downstream reset behavior.

REQ-FUNC-009.rationale: Every workflow stage needs safe resumable state and must not delete data outside its project or preservation policy.
REQ-FUNC-009.requirement: The operation runtime shall persist the shared compact operation-state envelope and JSON artifacts atomically, tolerate missing or malformed optional state, constrain all project-relative artifact paths to the active project, and reset only configured affected artifacts while preserving requested work.
REQ-FUNC-009.verification: Focused operation-runtime suite passed: 18 relevant tests within E-0009.

REQ-FUNC-010.rationale: Operators need a stable provider-selection contract before domain work begins.
REQ-FUNC-010.requirement: AI backend probing shall validate configured backend URLs/kinds, normalize OpenAI-compatible and Ollama model discovery, and return safe operator-facing connection failures.
REQ-FUNC-010.verification: Focused backend suite passed: 4 tests within E-0010.

REQ-FUNC-011.rationale: Downstream stages require stable, reviewable source partitions without provider dependence.
REQ-FUNC-011.requirement: Deterministic chunking shall derive ordered canonical chunks from clean text, preserve supported chapter structure, persist recoverable checkpoints atomically, and expose canonical chunks to downstream readers.
REQ-FUNC-011.verification: Focused deterministic chunking suite passed within E-0011.

REQ-FUNC-012.rationale: Parallel or malformed translation state would make downstream workflow decisions unsafe.
REQ-FUNC-012.requirement: AI Translation shall validate and atomically persist one authoritative target-language document aligned to canonical chunk IDs, deriving truthful translation/review/completion summaries.
REQ-FUNC-012.verification: Focused translation-service suite passed within E-0012.

REQ-FUNC-013.rationale: Voice and speech workflows need stable, reviewable character context without losing completed work.
REQ-FUNC-013.requirement: Character Discovery shall construct bounded source windows, request and normalize structured candidates, synthesize and merge reviewable profiles, preserve resumable/cancelled/failed progress, and validate/persist deliberate manual character changes.
REQ-FUNC-013.verification: Focused discovery-service suite passed: 31 tests within E-0013.

REQ-FUNC-014.rationale: TTS needs intentional, reviewable character assignments with durable sample artifacts.
REQ-FUNC-014.requirement: Character voice targets shall derive non-stereotyping prompts from character data, persist language, preview text, sample and assignment metadata atomically, and synchronize the selected narrator or per-character voice plan.
REQ-FUNC-014.verification: Focused character-voices service suite passed: 15 tests within E-0014.

REQ-FUNC-015.rationale: TTS requires a durable reviewable plan whose upstream changes do not leave stale audio.
REQ-FUNC-015.requirement: Speech-block orchestration shall resolve compatible ordered source chunks and voice assignments, persist/recover block artifacts, apply deliberate edits and approvals, and invalidate only affected downstream work.
REQ-FUNC-015.verification: Focused speech-blocks service suite passed within E-0015.

REQ-FUNC-016.rationale: Assembly needs durable ordered artifacts rather than ambiguous or malformed files.
REQ-FUNC-016.requirement: Audio-block artifacts shall use deterministic project-local names/paths and validate WAV inputs/outputs before they enter the generated-audio plan.
REQ-FUNC-016.verification: Focused artifact suite passed within E-0016.

REQ-FUNC-017.rationale: Operators need final artifacts without reimplementing upstream TTS behavior or accepting malformed inputs.
REQ-FUNC-017.requirement: Audio Assembly shall validate compatible ordered generated WAVs, compose resumable project-local outputs and ambience mixes, preserve safe output paths, and persist truthful output/report state.
REQ-FUNC-017.verification: Focused assembly-service suite passed within E-0017.

REQ-FUNC-018.rationale: An upstream revision must invalidate downstream work predictably without deleting preserved or unsafe artifacts.
REQ-FUNC-018.requirement: Workflow impact processing shall derive ordered full or selective invalidation summaries, retain stable identities during resequencing, and collect or delete only exact affected audio/assembly artifacts located inside the active project.
REQ-FUNC-018.verification: Focused workflow-impact and order suites passed: 15 relevant tests within E-0009.

REQ-FUNC-019.rationale: Long-running workflow actions need responsive, cancellable UI behavior without concurrent conflicting operations.
REQ-FUNC-019.requirement: The shared Qt operation runner and progress dialog shall run one worker at a time, relay progress and terminal results on the UI thread, support cooperative cancellation, restore UI/project-switch state after completion, and prevent unsafe application close while a worker remains active.
REQ-FUNC-019.verification: Focused runner, direct localized dialog, and shutdown suite passed: 6 relevant tests within E-0026.

REQ-FUNC-020.rationale: Domain pages need one controller-facing orchestration facade and must not use disabled or absent provider profiles.
REQ-FUNC-020.requirement: Workflow controllers shall delegate starts to the shared runner, project persisted operation state into the active manifest, and resolve only enabled AI profiles by identifier.
REQ-FUNC-020.verification: Focused workflow-controller suite passed: 3 relevant tests within E-0024 and E-0026, including persisted manifest synchronization.

REQ-FUNC-021.rationale: Domain services must not submit requests that cannot safely fit the selected profile context.
REQ-FUNC-021.requirement: Shared AI context budgeting shall reserve prompt/output/safety capacity, apply online-provider policy where configured, and reject requests below a workflow minimum text budget.
REQ-FUNC-021.verification: Focused budget suite passed: 4 tests within E-0010.

REQ-FUNC-022.rationale: Provider variance and malformed model output must not silently corrupt domain artifacts or leak credentials.
REQ-FUNC-022.requirement: The provider client shall execute cancellable JSON chat requests with compatible structured-output/token retries, bounded JSON repair, normalized usage, and sensitive-value redaction in transaction logs.
REQ-FUNC-022.verification: Focused provider suite passed: 18 tests within E-0010.

REQ-FUNC-023.rationale: Domain prompt contracts must fail clearly rather than submit malformed instructions.
REQ-FUNC-023.requirement: Prompt templates shall load only from their configured root, require exact replacement placeholders, and preserve braced source-text values.
REQ-FUNC-023.verification: Focused prompt suite passed: 2 tests within E-0010.

REQ-FUNC-024.rationale: Operators need one truthful cross-workflow usage representation.
REQ-FUNC-024.requirement: Token usage shall normalize, merge, restore, and localize available or unavailable provider usage from reports and operation state.
REQ-FUNC-024.verification: Focused AI runtime suites passed, including direct merge/restore coverage within E-0032.

REQ-FUNC-025.rationale: Operators require explicit, reviewable provider configuration.
REQ-FUNC-025.requirement: The AI Settings controller/page shall edit, validate, probe, localize, and persist AI profiles and workflow default selectors without losing manual model/context overrides.
REQ-FUNC-025.verification: Focused profile UI suites passed, including direct controller persistence/reload coverage within E-0032.

REQ-FUNC-026.rationale: Provider suggestions must not reorder, lose, or duplicate cleaned source content.
REQ-FUNC-026.requirement: AI chunking shall validate source-aligned semantic descriptors, checkpoint compatible window progress, preserve committed chunks on resume, and fall back safely when a provider returns no usable internal split.
REQ-FUNC-026.verification: Focused AI chunking suites passed within E-0011.

REQ-FUNC-027.rationale: Operators need safe manual correction without stale later-stage output.
REQ-FUNC-027.requirement: Text Chunking state shall project persisted chunk readiness, save chunk insert/delete/edit operations by stable ID, and apply workflow impact to affected downstream artifacts.
REQ-FUNC-027.verification: Focused chunking-state suite passed within E-0011.

REQ-FUNC-028.rationale: The workflow requires an operable, reviewable UI for chunk results.
REQ-FUNC-028.requirement: The Text Chunking controller/page shall route deterministic and AI requests through shared operations and present profile/strategy selection, previews, localization, find, and guarded chunk editing controls.
REQ-FUNC-028.verification: Focused chunking UI suites passed within E-0011.

REQ-FUNC-029.rationale: Chunk changes must not leave stale translation artifacts.
REQ-FUNC-029.requirement: Translation state shall project source/translated chunks and operator notes, synchronize chunk changes by stable ID, and preserve only compatible downstream work.
REQ-FUNC-029.verification: Focused translation-state suite passed within E-0012.

REQ-FUNC-030.rationale: Operators need a recoverable review loop before target text advances downstream.
REQ-FUNC-030.requirement: The translation controller/page shall route AI actions, debounce and flush edits, require review approval, and present localized profile/chunk/busy controls.
REQ-FUNC-030.verification: Focused translation UI suites passed within E-0012.

REQ-FUNC-031.rationale: The UI must present truthful runnable state and avoid starting a provider operation with invalid configuration.
REQ-FUNC-031.requirement: Character Discovery state shall select an enabled default character profile, project persisted character records and manual-maintenance flags, use compatible loaded chunks without rediscovery enrichment, and reject a run without a usable AI profile.
REQ-FUNC-031.verification: Focused discovery-state suite passed: 4 tests within E-0013.

REQ-FUNC-032.rationale: Operators need a safe review and correction boundary around AI-produced records.
REQ-FUNC-032.requirement: The Characters controller/page shall keep evidence review read-only until intentional edit/add actions, validate and persist manual records, restore selections on cancellation, coordinate resumable discovery, and preserve approved speech work when a voice-definition-only change permits it.
REQ-FUNC-032.verification: Focused Characters UI suites passed: 23 tests within E-0013.

REQ-FUNC-033.rationale: The Character Voices page must accurately distinguish reviewable assignments from actions that require missing prerequisites.
REQ-FUNC-033.requirement: Character voice state shall derive narrator-first targets, approved language, generated preview text, generation eligibility, missing-narrator warnings, and read-only refresh behavior.
REQ-FUNC-033.verification: Focused character-voices state suite passed: 6 tests within E-0014.

REQ-FUNC-034.rationale: Narrator choice must remain explicit and recoverable across project reloads and runtime changes.
REQ-FUNC-034.requirement: Narrator definition/state shall tolerate missing or torn legacy data, create/edit/select profiles, preserve independent stored samples, normalize runtime language and selection metadata, and project readiness/status without inventing a default narrator selection.
REQ-FUNC-034.verification: Focused narrator definition/state suites passed: 17 tests within E-0014.

REQ-FUNC-035.rationale: Generated profiles and imported audio must be safe to review without corrupting the existing voice inventory.
REQ-FUNC-035.requirement: Narrator profile generation/import shall use bounded approved text and operator rules, preserve existing profiles on invalid/cancelled work, resume checkpoints safely, record usage, and admit only valid audible WAV samples.
REQ-FUNC-035.verification: Focused profile-generation/import suites passed: 18 tests within E-0014.

REQ-FUNC-036.rationale: Operators need controllable per-character voice review without exposing implementation-specific runtime details.
REQ-FUNC-036.requirement: The Character Voices controller/page shall expose explicit edit/save/import/batch-generation flows, preserve samples on failed generation, synchronize project status, and redact runtime model identifiers from progress messages.
REQ-FUNC-036.verification: Focused Character Voices UI suites passed: 20 tests within E-0014.

REQ-FUNC-037.rationale: Narrator selection is a review gate whose long-running actions must be safe and understandable.
REQ-FUNC-037.requirement: The Narrator Voice controller/page shall keep selection and editor state explicit, update the manifest after deliberate selection, manage sample/profile generation with cancellation/failure recovery, and redact runtime model identifiers from progress.
REQ-FUNC-037.verification: Focused Narrator Voice UI suites passed: 20 tests within E-0014.

REQ-FUNC-038.rationale: Stored block records must have a consistent shape for review and TTS.
REQ-FUNC-038.requirement: Speech-block normalization shall produce stable IDs, valid content/speaker fields, operation rows, warning flags, and deterministic text/duration normalization.
REQ-FUNC-038.verification: Focused normalization suite passed within E-0015.

REQ-FUNC-039.rationale: UI and downstream workflow decisions require an accurate projection of the saved plan.
REQ-FUNC-039.requirement: Speech-block report/state services shall derive truthful counts, warnings, approval/readiness and persisted report projections without competing state.
REQ-FUNC-039.verification: Focused report/state suites passed within E-0015.

REQ-FUNC-040.rationale: Oversized or lossy text would make later synthesis unreliable.
REQ-FUNC-040.requirement: Speech-block text splitting shall retain compatible text and create TTS-budget-safe deterministic pieces.
REQ-FUNC-040.verification: Focused text-split suite passed within E-0015.

REQ-FUNC-041.rationale: Operators need a safe review boundary before audio creation.
REQ-FUNC-041.requirement: The Speech Blocks controller/page shall route generation and reset operations, expose guarded edits, warnings, selection and approval state, and refresh view state after recoverable outcomes.
REQ-FUNC-041.verification: Focused Speech Blocks UI suites passed within E-0015.

REQ-FUNC-042.rationale: Long audio work must be bounded and recoverable without losing completed audio.
REQ-FUNC-042.requirement: Audio-block orchestration/state/budget shall generate, resume, cancel and preserve ordered block artifacts while deriving truthful budget and UI state.
REQ-FUNC-042.verification: Focused generation/state/performance suites passed within E-0016.

REQ-FUNC-043.rationale: Generation must not begin from stale or unsupported local runtime assumptions.
REQ-FUNC-043.requirement: VoiceWeaver runtime support shall probe and expose only usable runtime capabilities and safely support configured TTS invocation.
REQ-FUNC-043.verification: Focused runtime suite passed within E-0016.

REQ-FUNC-044.rationale: Operators need a controllable, observable boundary around long TTS work.
REQ-FUNC-044.requirement: The Audio Blocks controller/page shall expose guarded generation, progress, recovery, artifact selection and playback state while integrating the main window safely.
REQ-FUNC-044.verification: Focused Audio Blocks UI/main-window suites passed within E-0016.

REQ-FUNC-045.rationale: Local runtime setup is a prerequisite that must be explicit to operators.
REQ-FUNC-045.requirement: TTS settings UI support shall surface probe/capability status and persist deliberate runtime/planning settings without enabling generation before required capabilities are ready.
REQ-FUNC-045.verification: Focused settings-page suite passed within E-0016; controller behavior is indirectly exercised through page integration.

REQ-FUNC-046.rationale: UI decisions must reflect actual generated audio rather than inferred progress.
REQ-FUNC-046.requirement: Assembly state shall derive readiness, saved output/mix metadata and recoverable project projections from persisted assembly artifacts.
REQ-FUNC-046.verification: Focused assembly-state suite passed within E-0017.

REQ-FUNC-047.rationale: Operators require an observable final review boundary.
REQ-FUNC-047.requirement: The Audio Assembly controller/page shall guard assembly operations, refresh output state after terminal outcomes, and expose deliberate output/mix selection and playback controls.
REQ-FUNC-047.verification: Focused assembly UI suites passed within E-0017.

REQ-FUNC-048.rationale: One authoritative validation boundary prevents divergent result, report, and resume state while making incompatible legacy data explicit.
REQ-FUNC-048.requirement: Text Chunking shall use one strict root-object `chunks_text.json` document with exactly the approved document and chunk fields, expose atomic load/write and defensive chunk-reader APIs, derive counts and effective status in memory, treat an absent document as not started, and reject every incompatible document with Reset Chunking guidance.
REQ-FUNC-048.verification: Strict document API contract suite passes.

REQ-FUNC-049.rationale: Crash-safe unit commits must never publish partial provider output or split canonical chunks from resumable operation state.
REQ-FUNC-049.requirement: Deterministic and AI-assisted Chunking shall atomically create the running document before work, commit only complete deterministic units or validated AI windows, emit progress only in memory, preserve committed chunks and resume fields on cancellation or failure, and complete with every paragraph represented and `next_paragraph` set to null.
REQ-FUNC-049.verification: Deterministic and AI lifecycle contract suite passes.

REQ-FUNC-050.rationale: Resume must continue the same source operation without coupling durable project state to stale provider configuration or a previous log file.
REQ-FUNC-050.requirement: AI Chunking resume shall accept only resumable AI-assisted documents whose source fingerprint matches current canonical clean text, reuse the stored strategy and normalized instructions, recalculate windows from the currently selected profile and settings, preserve cumulative usage and fallback count, and create a separate transaction log for each invocation without persisting its path.
REQ-FUNC-050.verification: AI resume contract uses stored operation data and current runtime profile.

REQ-FUNC-051.rationale: Operators need safe manual correction without corrupting origin metadata or embedding transient workflow-impact state.
REQ-FUNC-051.requirement: A successful manual chunk edit, insertion, or deletion shall atomically mutate only a strictly valid completed Chunking document, preserve document-level generation and audit fields, retain stable IDs where possible, give inserted chunks only minimal cleanup provenance, resequence chunks, set `manual_adjusted` true, and calculate downstream invalidation without persisting its payload.
REQ-FUNC-051.verification: Manual edit, insert, and delete preserve the strict root contract.

REQ-FUNC-052.rationale: Project recovery must be truthful and deterministic without silently repairing or migrating unsupported Chunking formats.
REQ-FUNC-052.requirement: Project lifecycle and reset logic shall derive Chunking completion and manifest summaries only from a strict completed non-empty Chunking document, shall not create Chunking state merely by opening its page, and shall require Reset Chunking for incompatible documents; Reset Chunking shall delete the authoritative document, matching AI logs, obsolete sidecars, and configured downstream artifacts without reading obsolete sidecars.
REQ-FUNC-052.verification: Lifecycle completion and page-open/reset contract tests derive from the document without sidecars.

REQ-FUNC-053.rationale: Every downstream stage must consume the new root-object artifact consistently without reintroducing legacy readers or persistence shortcuts.
REQ-FUNC-053.requirement: Translation, Character Discovery, narrator generation, Speech Blocks, Audio Blocks readiness, project validation, and exports shall obtain canonical chunks through the shared document reader, while Text Chunks export derives document-level mode, strategy, and counts and discovers separate AI logs without a persisted log path.
REQ-FUNC-053.verification: All required downstream modules route through the shared reader.

REQ-FUNC-054.rationale: Operators need an accurate workflow surface whose controls and notes reflect the sole persisted Chunking authority.
REQ-FUNC-054.requirement: The Text Chunking UI shall derive not-started, running, resumable, completed, warned, and manually adjusted states from the authoritative document, resume with its stored strategy and instructions and the currently selected AI profile without re-prompting, omit durable progress claims, and preserve existing rerun and reset confirmations.
REQ-FUNC-054.verification: Text Chunking UI state derives resume and strategy without durable progress.

REQ-NFR-001.rationale: A crash or failed replacement must not turn a previously valid project manifest or settings file into a partial payload.
REQ-NFR-001.requirement: Critical text and JSON persistence shall write a complete same-directory temporary file, flush and synchronize it, atomically replace the destination, and remove temporary files after failure.
REQ-NFR-001.verification: Automated focused pytest coverage passed for atomic replacement, failure preservation, cleanup, and manifest writer integration.

REQ-NFR-002.rationale: Long documents and provider-backed cleanup must recover from cancellation or interruption without publishing mixed-source or stale-profile output.
REQ-NFR-002.requirement: Extraction and cleanup operations shall persist resumable progress, reproduce uninterrupted output after compatible resume, and safely restart rather than reuse checkpoints when state is corrupt or relevant source/profile inputs are incompatible.
REQ-NFR-002.verification: Automated focused pytest coverage passed for extraction, deterministic cleanup, and AI cleanup resume, compatible output reproduction, and safe restart.

REQ-PLAT-001.rationale: Every domain requires a stable, safe platform configuration boundary.
REQ-PLAT-001.requirement: The application shall validate and persist shared settings, expose packaged configuration and localization resources, configure logging, scrolling and URLs, and apply validated theme/UI state through the settings UI without changing workflow-domain data.
REQ-PLAT-001.verification: Existing focused settings suite: linked schema, self-healing, persistence, theme, profile, runtime-cache, timeout, and URL validation behavior after traceability review.

REQ-SEC-001.rationale: Containment prevents untrusted project metadata or operator destinations from reading, deleting, overwriting, or recursively archiving files beyond the intended workspace.
REQ-SEC-001.requirement: Project-relative source and artifact paths shall reject absolute paths, parent traversal, and symlink escapes, and project export or snapshot destinations shall be outside the active project root.
REQ-SEC-001.verification: Automated focused pytest coverage passed for traversal, symlink escape, and external export or snapshot destinations.

REQ-UX-001.rationale: Operators need a reviewable and recoverable workflow surface that prevents unavailable actions and keeps visible state synchronized with persisted artifacts.
REQ-UX-001.requirement: The Text Cleanup page shall enable actions from project readiness, present source and cleaned previews with edit/find support, expose AI profile and spacing choices, and route extraction, cleanup, cancellation, edit, and spacing actions through its controller with project-state refresh.
REQ-UX-001.verification: Automated focused pytest coverage passed for action readiness, previews/editing, AI controls, operation dispatch, and project-state refresh.

REQ-UX-002.rationale: Every workflow domain depends on one predictable desktop shell while preserving its own state and service ownership.
REQ-UX-002.requirement: The desktop application shall expose a package and module entrypoint that initializes shared Qt settings before composing a themed main window with a fixed left navigation sidebar, current-page-only refresh, common help/about dialogs, and orderly audio/logging shutdown.
REQ-UX-002.verification: Existing focused app-shell suite: linked navigation, dialogs, localization, settings, help/about, and page-refresh behavior after traceability review.
